        "contents": "import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm'\nimport { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\n\n/**\n * DELETE /monitors/:id\n * Delete monitor (authentication required)\n * Related logs will be deleted automatically due to cascade delete\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  await requireUserSession(event)\n\n  const id = getRouterParam(event, 'id')\n\n  if (!id) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing monitor ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  const serviceId = Number.parseInt(id, 10)\n\n  if (Number.isNaN(serviceId)) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Invalid service ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Check if monitor exists\n  const existingService = await db.select().from(schema.services).where(eq(schema.services.id, serviceId)).limit(1)\n\n  if (existingService.length === 0) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 404,\n      statusMessage: 'Not Found',\n      message: 'Service not found',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Delete service (logs will be deleted automatically due to cascade)\n  await db.delete(schema.services).where(eq(schema.services.id, serviceId))\n\n  return {\n    success: true,\n    message: 'Monitor deleted successfully',\n  }\n})",

ServiceStatus.Down,\n      },\n      lastCheckTime,\n    })\n  }\n  return {\n    overviews,\n    timestamp: Temporal.Now.instant().toString(),\n  }\n})",

        "contents": "import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm'\nimport { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\n\n/**\n * GET /monitors/:id/logs\n * Get logs for a specific monitor (authentication required)\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  await requireUserSession(event)\n\n  const id = getRouterParam(event, 'id')\n\n  if (!id) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing monitor ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  const serviceId = Number.parseInt(id, 10)\n\n  if (Number.isNaN(serviceId)) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Invalid service ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Check if monitor exists\n  const existingService = await db.select().from(schema.services).where(eq(schema.services.id, serviceId)).limit(1)\n\n  if (existingService.length === 0) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 404,\n      statusMessage: 'Not Found',\n      message: 'Monitor not found',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Get query parameters for pagination\n  const query = getQuery(event)\n  const limit = query.limit ? Number.parseInt(query.limit as string, 10) : 30\n  const offset = query.offset ? Number.parseInt(query.offset as string, 10) : 0\n\n  const logs = await getServiceLogs(serviceId, limit, offset)\n\n  return logs\n})",

        "contents": "import { desc, eq } from 'drizzle-orm'\nimport { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\n\nexport async function checkService(service: typeof schema.services.$inferSelect) {\n  const startTime = Date.now()\n\n  let status: 'up' | 'timeout' | 'error' = 'up'\n\n  let errorMessage: string = ''\n\n  const response = await $fetch.raw(service.url, {\n    method: service.method || 'GET',\n    headers: {\n      'User-Agent': 'Pulse/1.0',\n    },\n    timeout: 30000,\n    retry: 3,\n    onRequestError({ error }) {\n      status = 'error'\n      errorMessage = error.message\n    },\n    onResponseError({ error }) {\n      if (error?.name === 'TimeoutError') {\n        status = 'timeout'\n        errorMessage = 'Request timed out'\n      }\n      else {\n        status = 'error'\n        errorMessage = error?.message ??         "contents": "import { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\nimport { checkService } from '~~/server/utils/service'\n\nexport default defineTask({\n  meta: {\n    name: 'check',\n    description: 'Check status for all services',\n  },\n  async run() {\n    // Fetch all services from database\n    const services = await db.select().from(schema.services)\n\n    // Process each service\n    for (const service of services) {\n      await checkService(service)\n    }\n\n    return {\n      result: 'success',\n    }\n  },\n})",
        "signatures": {},

          {
            "text": "  },",
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "  async run() {",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Fetch all services from database",
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "    const services = await db.select().from(schema.services)",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "    // Process each service",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "text": "    for (const service of services) {",
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "      await checkService(service)",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "    return {",

          },

            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "text": "    }",
            "lineNumber": 20
          },

            "lineNumber": 21
          },

        "contents": "export function getServiceStatus(\n  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],\n): ServiceStatus {\n  const now = Temporal.Now.instant()\n  const halfDayAgo = now.subtract(Temporal.Duration.from({ hours: 12 }))\n  const halfDayAgoDate = new Date(halfDayAgo.epochMilliseconds)\n\n  // Filter logs from the last 12 hours\n  const recentLogs = logs.filter((log) =&gt; {\n    const logDate = log.timestamp instanceof Date ? log.timestamp : new Date(log.timestamp)\n    return logDate &gt;= halfDayAgoDate\n  })\n\n  // If no logs in the last 12 hours, return down\n  if (recentLogs.length === 0) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Down\n  }\n\n  // Count successful logs (status === 'up')\n  const upCount = recentLogs.filter(log =&gt; log.status === 'up').length\n  const uptime = (upCount / recentLogs.length) * 100\n\n  // Calculate status based on uptime percentage\n  if (uptime &gt;= 99.5) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Operational\n  }\n  else if (uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Degraded\n  }\n  else {\n    return ServiceStatus.Down\n  }\n}\n\nexport function getOutages(histories: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[]) {\n  // Returns an array of outage periods: [{ from: Temporal.ZonedDateTime, duration: Temporal.Duration }]\n}",

        "contents": "export function getOutages(histories: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[]) {\n  // Returns an array of outage periods: [{ from: Temporal.ZonedDateTime, duration: Temporal.Duration }]\n  // Outage is defined as contiguous logs where status !== 'up'\n\n  if (!histories || histories.length === 0)\n    return []\n\n  // Make sure logs are ordered\n  const sorted = [...histories].sort((a, b) =&gt; {\n    const aDate = a.timestamp instanceof Date ? a.timestamp.getTime() : new Date(a.timestamp).getTime()\n    const bDate = b.timestamp instanceof Date ? b.timestamp.getTime() : new Date(b.timestamp).getTime()\n    return aDate - bDate\n  })\n\n  const outages: { from: Temporal.ZonedDateTime, duration: Temporal.Duration }[] = []\n\n  let inOutage = false\n  let outageStart: Temporal.ZonedDateTime | null = null\n  let lastTimestamp: Temporal.ZonedDateTime | null = null\n\n  for (const log of sorted) {\n    const logDate = log.timestamp instanceof Date\n      ? Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(log.timestamp.getTime()).toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n      : Temporal.Instant.fromEpochMilliseconds(new Date(log.timestamp).getTime()).toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n\n    if (log.status !== 'up') {\n      if (!inOutage) {\n        inOutage = true\n        outageStart = logDate\n      }\n    }\n    else {\n      if (inOutage &amp;&amp; outageStart) {\n        // Outage ends at previous log's timestamp\n        const duration = logDate.since(outageStart)\n        outages.push({ from: outageStart, duration })\n        inOutage = false\n        outageStart = null\n      }\n    }\n    lastTimestamp = logDate\n  }\n\n  // If still in outage at the end, measure until lastTimestamp (last log)\n  if (inOutage &amp;&amp; outageStart &amp;&amp; lastTimestamp) {\n    const duration = lastTimestamp.since(outageStart)\n    outages.push({ from: outageStart, duration })\n  }\n\n  return outages\n}",

        "contents": "export function manageServiceLogsByDays(\n  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],\n) {\n  const now = Temporal.Now.instant().toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC')\n\n  const serviceLogsByDays = new Map(\n    Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) =&gt; {\n      const date = now.subtract(Temporal.Duration.from({ days: i }))\n        .startOfDay()\n        .toString()\n      const logsByDay: ServiceLogsByDays = {\n        get total() {\n          return this.logs.length\n        },\n        get upCount() {\n          return this.logs.filter(log =&gt; log.status === 'up').length\n        },\n        get uptime() {\n          return this.upCount / this.total * 100\n        },\n        logs: [],\n        get latency() {\n          return this.logs.at(-1)?.latency ?? null\n        },\n        get outages() {\n          return getOutages(this.logs)\n        },\n      }\n      return [date, logsByDay]\n    }),\n  )\n\n  for (const log of logs) {\n    const date = log.timestamp.toTemporalInstant().toZonedDateTimeISO('UTC').startOfDay()\n    const serviceLogsByDay = serviceLogsByDays.get(date.toString())\n    if (serviceLogsByDay) {\n      serviceLogsByDay.logs.push(log)\n    }\n  }\n\n  return serviceLogsByDays\n}\n\nexport function getServiceStatus(\n  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],\n): ServiceStatus {\n  \n}",

        "contents": "import { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\nimport { z } from 'zod'\n\nconst createServiceSchema = z.object({\n  name: z.string().min(1, 'Name is required'),\n  url: z.url('Invalid URL format'),\n  method: z.enum(['GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'PATCH', 'DELETE', 'HEAD', 'OPTIONS']).default('GET'),\n  tags: z.array(z.string()).default([]),\n  type: z.enum(['public', 'private']).default('public'),\n})\n\n/**\n * POST /services\n * Add new service (authentication required)\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  await requireUserSession(event)\n\n  const validateBody = await readValidatedBody(event, createServiceSchema.safeParse)\n  if (!validateBody.success) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: validateBody.error.message,\n    })\n  }\n\n  const body = validateBody.data\n\n  // Validate required fields\n  if (!body.name || !body.url) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing required fields: name, url',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Insert new monitor\n  const [newService] = await db.insert(schema.services).values({\n    name: body.name,\n    url: body.url,\n    method: body.method,\n    tags: body.tags,\n    type: body.type,\n  }).returning()\n\n  return {\n    monitor: newService,\n  }\n})",

        "contents": "import { eq } from 'drizzle-orm'\nimport { db, schema } from 'hub:db'\n\n/**\n * DELETE /monitors/:id\n * Delete monitor (authentication required)\n * Related logs will be deleted automatically due to cascade delete\n */\nexport default defineEventHandler(async (event) =&gt; {\n  // Verify authentication\n  await requireUserSession(event)\n\n  const id = getRouterParam(event, 'id')\n\n  if (!id) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Missing monitor ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  const serviceId = Number.parseInt(id, 10)\n\n  if (Number.isNaN(serviceId)) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 400,\n      statusMessage: 'Bad Request',\n      message: 'Invalid service ID',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Check if monitor exists\n  const existingService = await db.select().from(schema.services).where(eq(schema.services.id, serviceId)).limit(1)\n\n  if (existingService.length === 0) {\n    throw createError({\n      statusCode: 404,\n      statusMessage: 'Not Found',\n      message: 'Service not found',\n    })\n  }\n\n  // Delete service (logs will be deleted automatically due to cascade)\n  await db.delete(schema.services).where(eq(schema.services.id, serviceId))\n\n  return {\n    success: true,\n    message: 'Monitor deleted successfully',\n  }\n})",

        "contents": "export function getServiceStatus(\n  logs: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[],\n): ServiceStatus {\n  const now = Temporal.Now.instant()\n  const halfDayAgo = now.subtract(Temporal.Duration.from({ hours: 12 }))\n  const halfDayAgoDate = new Date(halfDayAgo.epochMilliseconds)\n\n  // Filter logs from the last 12 hours\n  const recentLogs = logs.filter((log) =&gt; {\n    const logDate = log.timestamp instanceof Date ? log.timestamp : new Date(log.timestamp)\n    return logDate &gt;= halfDayAgoDate\n  })\n\n  // If no logs in the last 12 hours, return down\n  if (recentLogs.length === 0) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Down\n  }\n\n  // Count successful logs (status === 'up')\n  const upCount = recentLogs.filter(log =&gt; log.status === 'up').length\n  const uptime = (upCount / recentLogs.length) * 100\n\n  // Calculate status based on uptime percentage\n  if (uptime &gt;= 99.5) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Operational\n  }\n  else if (uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return ServiceStatus.Degraded\n  }\n  else {\n    return ServiceStatus.Down\n  }\n}\n\nexport function getOutages(histories: typeof schema.serviceLogs.$inferSelect[]) {\n  // Returns an array of outage periods: [{ from: Temporal.ZonedDateTime, duration: Temporal.Duration }]\n}",

        "contents": "---\nalwaysApply: true\n---\n# Overview\n\nThis is an uptime monitoring website built with Nuxt 4 and Nuxthub, and styling with unocss.\n\n## NPM package manager\n\nShould be pnpm, but alway install package with &#96;[ni](https://github.com/antfu-collective/ni)&#96; and related command.\n\n## How to use Nuxthub?\n\nNuxthub is a Nuxt module provider a complete backend experience on top of the framework that can deploy on many cloud providers, allowing developers to build full-stack applications.\n\n### Database\n\n- **Database Dialect**: The database dialect is set in the &#96;nuxt.config.ts&#96; file, within the &#96;hub.db&#96; option or &#96;hub.db.dialect&#96; property.\n- **Drizzle Config**: Don't generate the &#96;drizzle.config.ts&#96; file manually, it is generated automatically by NuxtHub.\n- **Generate Migrations**: Use &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to automatically generate database migrations from schema changes\n- **Never Write Manual Migrations**: Do not manually create SQL migration files in the &#96;server/db/migrations/&#96; directory\n- **Workflow**:\n  1. Create or modify the database schema in &#96;server/db/schema.ts&#96; or any other schema file in the &#96;server/db/schema/&#96; directory\n  2.         "contents": "&lt;script setup lang=\"ts\"&gt;\nimport type { SerializeObject } from 'nitropack'\n\nconst props = defineProps&lt;{\n  overview: SerializeObject&lt;ServiceOverview&gt;\n}&gt;()\n\nfunction getStatusColor(status: ServiceStatus): string {\n  switch (status) {\n    case ServiceStatus.Operational: return 'bg-emerald-500'\n    case ServiceStatus.Degraded: return 'bg-amber-400'\n    case ServiceStatus.Down: return 'bg-rose-500'\n    case ServiceStatus.Maintenance: return 'bg-blue-400'\n    default: return 'bg-gray-400'\n  }\n}\n\nfunction getStatusText(status: ServiceStatus): string {\n  switch (status) {\n    case ServiceStatus.Operational: return '运行正常'\n    case ServiceStatus.Degraded: return '性能降低'\n    case ServiceStatus.Down: return '服务中断'\n    case ServiceStatus.Maintenance: return '维护中'\n    default: return '未知状态'\n  }\n}\n\n// Calculate 30-day uptime percentage\nconst uptimePercentage = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (!props.overview.histories || props.overview.histories.length === 0) {\n    return 0\n  }\n\n  const validHistories = props.overview.histories.filter(h =&gt; h.uptime !== null)\n  if (validHistories.length === 0) {\n    return 0\n  }\n\n  const totalUptime = validHistories.reduce((sum, h) =&gt; sum + (h.uptime ?? 0), 0)\n  return totalUptime / validHistories.length\n})\n\n// Get latest latency from most recent history\nconst latestLatency = computed(() =&gt; {\n  const histories = [...props.overview.histories].sort((a, b) =&gt;\n    Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from(b.date).epochMilliseconds - Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from(a.date).epochMilliseconds,\n  )\n  return histories.find(h =&gt; h.latency !== null)?.latency ?? null\n})\n\n// Get last check time from overview\nconst lastCheckTime = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (!props.overview.lastCheckTime) {\n    return null\n  }",

        "contents": "---\nalwaysApply: true\n---\n# Overview\n\nThis is an uptime monitoring website built with Nuxt 4 and Nuxthub, and styling with unocss.\n\n## NPM package manager\n\nShould be pnpm, but alway install package with &#96;[ni](https://github.com/antfu-collective/ni)&#96; and related command.\n\n## How to use Nuxthub?\n\nNuxthub is a Nuxt module provider a complete backend experience on top of the framework that can deploy on many cloud providers, allowing developers to build full-stack applications.\n\n### Database\n\n- **Database Dialect**: The database dialect is set in the &#96;nuxt.config.ts&#96; file, within the &#96;hub.db&#96; option or &#96;hub.db.dialect&#96; property.\n- **Drizzle Config**: Don't generate the &#96;drizzle.config.ts&#96; file manually, it is generated automatically by NuxtHub.\n- **Generate Migrations**: Use &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to automatically generate database migrations from schema changes\n- **Never Write Manual Migrations**: Do not manually create SQL migration files in the &#96;server/db/migrations/&#96; directory\n- **Workflow**:\n  1. Create or modify the database schema in &#96;server/db/schema.ts&#96; or any other schema file in the &#96;server/db/schema/&#96; directory\n  2. Run &#96;npx nuxt db generate&#96; to generate the migration\n  3. Run &#96;npx nuxt db migrate&#96; to apply the migration to the database, or run &#96;npx nuxt dev&#96; to apply the migration during development\n- **Access the database**: Use the &#96;db&#96; instance from &#96;hub:db&#96; to query the database, it is a Drizzle ORM instance.\n- **Access the database schema**: Use the &#96;schema&#96; from &#96;hub:db&#96; to access the schemas.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {

        "contents": "&lt;script setup lang=\"ts\"&gt;\nconst { data } = useQuery({\n  key: ['overview'],\n  query: () =&gt; $fetch('/api/services/overviews'),\n})\n\nconst isSystemHealthy = computed(() =&gt; data.value?.overviews.every(overview =&gt; overview.service.status === ServiceStatus.Operational))\n\nconst activeServices = computed(() =&gt; data.value?.overviews.filter(overview =&gt; overview.service.status === ServiceStatus.Operational).length)\nconst totalServices = computed(() =&gt; data.value?.overviews.length ?? 0)\n\nconst averageUptime = computed(() =&gt; {\n  const uptimes = data.value?.overviews.reduce((acc, overview) =&gt; {\n    const serviceUptime = overview.histories.reduce((acc, history) =&gt; acc + (history.uptime ?? 0), 0) ?? 0\n    return acc + serviceUptime\n  }, 0) ?? 0\n\n  return (uptimes / totalServices.value).toFixed(2)\n})\n&lt;/script&gt;\n\n&lt;template&gt;\n  &lt;div mb-12&gt;\n    &lt;div\n      relative of-hidden",

        "contents": "&lt;script setup lang=\"ts\"&gt;\nimport type { SerializeObject } from 'nitropack'\n\nimport { Tooltip } from '@ark-ui/vue/tooltip'\n\nconst props = defineProps&lt;{\n  history: SerializeObject&lt;ServiceHistroy&gt;\n}&gt;()\n\nconst uptimeBgColor = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (props.history.uptime === null) {\n    return 'bg-gray-400'\n  }\n  if (props.history.uptime &gt;= 99.9) {\n    return 'bg-emerald-500'\n  }\n  else if (props.history.uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return 'bg-amber-400'\n  }\n  else {\n    return 'bg-rose-500'\n  }\n})\n\nconst uptimeTextColor = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (props.history.uptime === null) {\n    return 'text-gray-400'\n  }\n  if (props.history.uptime &gt;= 99.9) {\n    return 'text-emerald-500'\n  }\n  else if (props.history.uptime &gt; 98) {\n    return 'text-amber-400'\n  }\n  else {\n    return 'text-rose-500'\n  }\n})\n\nconst latencyColor = computed(() =&gt; {\n  if (props.history.latency === null) {\n    return 'text-gray-400'\n  }\n  if (props.history.latency &gt; 800) {\n    return 'text-rose-500'\n  }\n  else if (props.history.latency &gt; 500) {\n    return 'text-amber-400'\n  }\n  else {\n    return 'text-emerald-500'\n  }\n})\n\nconst outages = computed&lt;string[]&gt;(() =&gt; {\n  return props.history.outages.map((outage) =&gt; {\n    const from = Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from(outage.from)\n      .withTimeZone(Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone)\n    const duration = Temporal.Duration.from(outage.duration)\n    const to = from.add(duration)\n\n    const fromString = from.toLocaleString('zh-CN', {\n      timeStyle: 'long',\n      hourCycle: 'h24',\n    })\n\n    const endString = to.toLocaleString('zh-CN', {\n      timeStyle: 'long',\n      hourCycle: 'h24',\n    })\n\n    return &#96;${fromString} ~ ${endString}&#96;\n  })\n})\n\nconst datetime = computed(() =&gt; {\n  const instant = Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from(props.history.date)\n    .withTimeZone(Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone)\n  return new Date(instant.epochMilliseconds)\n})\n&lt;/script&gt;\n\n&lt;template&gt;\n  &lt;Tooltip.Root&gt;\n    &lt;Tooltip.Trigger class=\"group relative flex-1 h-8 min-w-[4px] mx-[1px] first:ml-0 last:mr-0\"&gt;\n      ",

          },
          {

          },
          {

          },
          {

          {

          {

          },
          {

        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./README.md",
        "range": {
          "startPosition": {},
          "endPosition": {
            "line": 49
          }
        },
        "contents": "# NuxtPulse\n\nNuxtPulse is a modern uptime monitoring / status page\n\nNuxtPulse base on Nuxt.js and [@nuxthub/core](https://nuxt.com/modules/hub), learn more on [hub.nuxt.com](https://hub.nuxt.com/).\n\n## Features\n\n&gt; WIP\n\n## Development\n\n### Setup\n\nMake sure to install the dependencies with pnpm.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\npnpm install\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nThen start development server with &#96;dev&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\npnpm dev\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Deploy\n\n### Vercel\n\nOn the Vercel dashboard -&gt; Storage, create a Turso SQLite database.\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\nnpm run deploy-vercel\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nLink the newly created resources to your project and re-deploy.\n\nYou can also connect using your git repository to leverage Vercel's CI/CD pipeline.\n\n### Cloudflare worker\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;sh\nnpm run deploy-cloudflare\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nWrangler will create the necessary resources on your Cloudflare account.\n\nYou can also connect using your git repository to leverage Cloudflare's CI/CD pipeline.",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "# NuxtPulse",
            "lineNumber": 1
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 2
          },
          {
            "text": "NuxtPulse is a modern uptime monitoring / status page",
            "lineNumber": 3
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 4
          },
          {
            "text": "NuxtPulse base on Nuxt.js and [@nuxthub/core](https://nuxt.com/modules/hub), learn more on [hub.nuxt.com](https://hub.nuxt.com/).",
            "lineNumber": 5
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 6
          },
          {
            "text": "## Features",
            "lineNumber": 7
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 8
          },
          {
            "text": "&gt; WIP",
            "lineNumber": 9
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 10
          },
          {
            "text": "## Development",
            "lineNumber": 11
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 12
          },
          {
            "text": "### Setup",
            "lineNumber": 13
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 14
          },
          {
            "text": "Make sure to install the dependencies with pnpm.",
            "lineNumber": 15
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 16
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sh",
            "lineNumber": 17
          },
          {
            "text": "pnpm install",
            "lineNumber": 18
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 19
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 20
          },
          {
            "text": "Then start development server with &#96;dev&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 21
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 22
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sh",
            "lineNumber": 23
          },
          {
            "text": "pnpm dev",
            "lineNumber": 24
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 25
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 26
          },
          {
            "text": "## Deploy",
            "lineNumber": 27
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 28
          },
          {
            "text": "### Vercel",
            "lineNumber": 29
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 30
          },
          {
            "text": "On the Vercel dashboard -&gt; Storage, create a Turso SQLite database.",
            "lineNumber": 31
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 32
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sh",
            "lineNumber": 33
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run deploy-vercel",
            "lineNumber": 34
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 35
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 36
          },
          {
            "text": "Link the newly created resources to your project and re-deploy.",
            "lineNumber": 37
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 38
          },
          {
            "text": "You can also connect using your git repository to leverage Vercel's CI/CD pipeline.",
            "lineNumber": 39
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 40
          },
          {
            "text": "### Cloudflare worker",
            "lineNumber": 41
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 42
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;sh",
            "lineNumber": 43
          },
          {
            "text": "npm run deploy-cloudflare",
            "lineNumber": 44
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 45
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 46
          },
          {
            "text": "Wrangler will create the necessary resources on your Cloudflare account.",
            "lineNumber": 47
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 48
          },
          {
            "text": "You can also connect using your git repository to leverage Cloudflare's CI/CD pipeline.",
            "lineNumber": 49
          }
        ]
      },
      "score": 0.09939473867416382
    },

When displaying time on the client side, ensure it is converted to the user's timezone using &#96;Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone&#96;.\n3. Use **&#96;Temporal&#96;** APIs instead of the &#96;Date&#96; object for time processing.\n4. Since server API responses are serialized into strings when returning JSON data, you must process time data according to the actual type returned by the server. For example, if the server returns a &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime&#96;, the client must use &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime.from&#96; to reconstruct the &#96;Temporal.ZonedDateTime&#96; object.
